name: back
description: Go back to the previous page in history. Returns what changed.

name: click
description: Click an element by ref (button, link, checkbox…). Returns what changed on the page.

ref.description: element ref from the snapshot, e.g. e5

name: console_list
description: List browser console messages and uncaught errors with their source file:line.

level.description: error, warn (warnings and errors) or all (default)

name: emulate
description: Simulate a phone/tablet screen or a slow/offline network. Use desktop and none to go back to normal.

name: flow_list
description: List saved flows with their description and parameters.

name: flow_run
description: Run a saved flow step by step without AI. On failure it stops and shows the step, the reason and the page.

params.description: values for the flow parameters, e.g. {numero: 2048}

name: flow_save
description: Save the actions done so far (each action ends with 'flow step #N') as a reusable flow. Use params to turn typed values into placeholders.

description.description: what the flow does, in one sentence

fromStep.description: first step number to save (default: everything since the last flow_save)

name.description: file name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _

params.description: turn typed values into parameters: {name: value used in this session}, e.g. {numero: 1023}

name: inspect
description: Show the computed styles of an element (color, background, font, border, size), its states and aria attributes.

props.description: extra CSS properties to read, e.g. outline-color

name: mock_add
description: Fake an API response or failure for matching requests (e.g. return 500 or slow down). The newest mock wins. Reload or repeat the action to see the effect.

body.description: response body, e.g. a JSON string

delayMs.description: wait this long before answering (to see loading states)

fail.description: simulate a network failure instead: timeout, connection_refused, offline, dns, aborted…

times.description: apply only N times, then expire (default: unlimited)

urlPattern.description: URL glob like */api/orders* (text without * matches anywhere in the URL)

name: mock_clear
description: Remove one mock by id, or all mocks when no id is given.

id.description: mock id like m1; without id removes all mocks

name: mock_list
description: List active mocks and how many times each was used.

name: network_get
description: Show one request from network_list: headers, request payload and response body (JSON formatted).

name: network_list
description: List the page's network requests (id METHOD STATUS URL). Use to check which API calls ran and which failed.

filter.description: text that the URL must contain

limit.description: max requests to show, newest last (default 20)

method.description: HTTP method, e.g. GET or POST

status.description: 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx, failed, error (4xx/5xx/failed), pending or an exact code

type.description: resource type: xhr, fetch, document, script, stylesheet, image…

name: open
description: Open a URL in the browser. Returns a snapshot of the page with element refs (e1, e2…) to use in other tools.

url.description: address to open, e.g. https://example.com or localhost:3000

name: press
description: Press a keyboard key on the focused element, e.g. Enter, Escape, Tab.

key.description: key name like Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, or a combo like Control+A

name: screenshot
description: Take a picture of the page with element refs drawn on it. Use when layout, colors or images matter.

fullPage.description: capture the whole page, not only the visible area

marks.description: draw element refs on the image (default true)

ref.description: crop the image around this element

name: scroll
description: Scroll to an element by ref, or the page up/down. Returns the elements that came into view.

amount.description: pixels to scroll (default: most of the screen)

ref.description: scroll until this element is visible

name: select
description: Choose an option in a dropdown (combobox) by its label or value.

option.description: label or value of the option

name: snapshot
description: Show the current page as text with element refs. Call it when you need to see the page again or after an error. Shows the visible area (header scroll: Y/MAX); scroll or use full=true for the rest. Long texts are cut at 80 chars with …; use scope=<ref> to read them in full.

full.description: include elements outside the visible area

scope.description: ref of an element to show only its subtree, with all its items and full texts

name: type
description: Type text into a field by ref. Clears it first unless clear=false; submit=true presses Enter. Never use for passwords.

clear.description: clear the field before typing (default true)

name: wait_for
description: Wait until a visible text (or element ref) appears, or disappears with gone=true. Use after actions that load data slowly.

gone.description: wait until the text or element disappears
